authoritativeItemSource: existing Equipment 2.0 server pinned draft / expanded 48-set review / two T5 rare review sets
contract: Damage type is verified server-authored event metadata, never client-supplied and never a randomized retag of legacy items
No new item identity, item stats, innate stat, affix, rarity roll, price, recipe, source grant, craft requirement, character-level gate or market eligibility is authorized by this review
Subtype weights sum to 10000 basis points only for verified physical weapon strike profiles; spell-source wand has no physical type
Blunt shield bash requires a distinct authenticated skill effect; equipping a shield never automatically adds Blunt to all attacks
Armor material candidates are display/review grouping only, not automatic subtype resistances or vulnerabilities
Normal physical armor mitigation and existing generic penetration apply once; subtype modifiers evaluate post-mitigation; round once
Proc, DoT, reflect, shields, healing and elemental/true damage do not inherit a new subtype unless individually authored and verified
No live/staging merge, gameplay activation, UI/theme activation, backend migrations or market changes before coordinated 2.0 approval
The ten T4 Citadel/Bloodsteel draft identities are retired and must never be registered, minted, crafted, assigned art or market-listed; the T5 IDs supersede them.
